raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Fix the first incremental multimodal sibling's prefix-cache miss on Mamba-attention hybrid models by retaining a state at the producer's final multimodal boundary. Addresses the reproduced 4-image -> 5-image case in #43587.

## Claims

- Make a block-aligned Mamba state available before the sibling diverges.
- Add at most one extra split per uninterrupted prefill pass and one retained checkpoint per multimodal request.
- Preserve the tested identical-prompt and text-only cache-hit counts.

## Validation

Tested PR head: `0deefd9dbde58a27eecf16d6ae61a4f2b2192730`; baseline: `4611c2c3d2`.

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q \
  tests/v1/core/test_mamba_align_chunk_split.py \
  tests/v1/core/prefix_cache/test_partial_prefix_cache_hits.py \
  tests/v1/core/test_prefix_caching.py
# 395 passed
.venv/bin/pre-commit run --files \
  vllm/v1/request.py vllm/v1/core/kv_cache_coordinator.py \
  vllm/v1/core/sched/scheduler.py tests/v1/core/test_mamba_align_chunk_split.py
# Passed, including mypy and CI test tethering
git diff --check
```

The two added producer/consumer cases fail on baseline with 0 cached tokens instead of 528/1600 and pass on the PR. The suites also pass against an independently installed, full source-built PR wheel (CUDA 12.9, SM86, fresh C++/CUDA and Rust artifacts). The submitter reviewed the diff and personally ran that wheel's tests: **395 passed, 14 deprecation warnings**.

**4B GPU reproducer:** Qwen3.5-4B, 2 x RTX A6000, TP=2, BF16, eager, prefix caching, Mamba `align`, 528-token blocks, max length/batch 8192, max sequences 4, 2 GiB cache/rank. Images are gray RGB, 224px or 448px, with `max_pixels=image_size**2`.

| Case | Baseline cached tokens | PR cached tokens |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| 224px, padded / long-tail 4 -> 5 images | 0 / 0 | 1584 / 1584 |
| 448px, padded / long-tail 4 -> 5 images | 0 / 0 | 2112 / 2112 |
| 448px, shorter 4 -> 5 images | 528 | 528 |
| Identical 4-image replay, 224px / 448px | 2112 / 2640 | 2112 / 2640 |
| Text-only, vision enabled | 4224 | 4224 |

All eight patched cached/skip-cache comparisons match for 16 greedy output tokens. These initial TP2 runs used checkout-specific Python with v0.29.0 extensions; expanded PR runs below use the independent full-build wheel.

| Expanded validation | Result / limitation |
| --- | --- |
| 4B TP1/TP2, default CUDA graphs, 512-token outputs | Text replay controls pass; strict long-MM token equality fails in some profiles. The full wheel reproduces the mismatch; actual SSM replay is exact in all 24 layers. |
| 4B concurrent4, 2048-token outputs, actual decode preemption | All requests complete, two recorded preemptions; post-batch replay/skip controls pass. The graph/sync-check profile completes with `VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error`. |
| 27B TP2, FP8 KV/BF16 SSM, default graphs | Tested Intel/Qwen3.5-27B-int4-AutoRound, RedHatAI/Qwen3.8-27B-INT4 and dbirks/Qwen3.8-27B-W4A16-AutoRound. First MM sibling hit improves 0 -> 3200; 512-token MM/text cached/skip controls pass. |
| 27B post-batch replay | Some controls fail. RedHatAI has one PR failure with all corresponding baseline controls passing; the reduced boundary ablation does not reproduce it. This remains unresolved. |
| Qwen3.8 concurrent4, approximately 52K-token prompts / 512 outputs | All four replays hit 52,000 tokens, but strict cached/skip comparisons fail on both PR and matched baseline. Cache reuse does not establish output equality. |
| 27B actual prefill/decode preemption, 2048 outputs | Requests complete. Post-batch cache states are evicted, so these runs do not establish cached-state recovery. |

The tested 27B checkpoints are distinct; the reporter's exact artifact is unconfirmed. Their vision-enabled text-only zero-hit case was not reproduced. This PR does not claim to fix every configuration in #43587 or establish universal baseline/PR output identity. Teacher-forced checks also exceed some borrowed numerical bounds on both baseline and PR.

**Performance:** 4B TP1/default graphs, 30 randomized paired cold-prefill trials after two excluded warmup pairs: extra-MM-boundary enabled/ablated median ratio **1.0350**, bootstrap95% CI **[1.0295, 1.0383]** (~3.5% overhead). This is a same-engine `Request.last_mm_feature_end` ablation, not separate upstream builds or server TTFT; target-GPU samples contain only the test process, but the host is shared.

Upstream CI is blocked by [contributor admission](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/actions/runs/37878028036/job/113650981764); downstream checks did not run.

<details>
<summary>GPU reproducer</summary>

Run in a fresh Python process for each checkout, after installing that checkout's GPU dependencies. Use `MODEL=/path/to/Qwen3.5-4B IMAGE_SIZE=224` or `448`. The upstream 448px run can stop at the baseline output mismatch described above.

```python
import os

from PIL import Image
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
from vllm import LLM, SamplingParams

model = os.environ["MODEL"]
size = int(os.environ.get("IMAGE_SIZE", "224"))
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model, local_files_only=True)
image = Image.new("RGB", (size, size), (128, 128, 128))
llm = LLM(
    model=model,
    tensor_parallel_size=2,
    dtype="bfloat16",
    enforce_eager=True,
    enable_prefix_caching=True,
    max_model_len=8192,
    max_num_batched_tokens=8192,
    max_num_seqs=4,
    gpu_memory_utilization=0.26,
    kv_cache_memory_bytes=2 * 1024**3,
    limit_mm_per_prompt={"image": 5, "video": 0},
    mm_processor_kwargs={"max_pixels": size**2},
    seed=0,
)


def prompt(n, repeats=300, tail=0):
    items = [{"type": "text", "text": "Task description.\n\nHistory:\n"}]
    for i in range(n):
        items += [
            {"type": "text", "text": f"\n--- Turn {i + 1} ---\n"},
            {"type": "image", "image": image},
        ]
    items.append({
        "type": "text",
        "text": "\n" + "Follow these instructions carefully. " * tail + "\nWhat next?",
    })
    messages = [
        {"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant. " * repeats},
        {"role": "user", "content": items},
    ]
    value = {"prompt": tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
        messages, add_generation_prompt=True, tokenize=False,
    )}
    if n:
        value["multi_modal_data"] = {"image": [image] * n}
    return value


def run(name, value, skip=False):
    output = llm.generate([value], SamplingParams(
        temperature=0, max_tokens=16, skip_reading_prefix_cache=skip,
    ), use_tqdm=False)[0]
    print(name, len(output.prompt_token_ids), output.num_cached_tokens)
    return list(output.outputs[0].token_ids)


try:
    for repeats in (30, 300):
        assert llm.reset_prefix_cache()
        run(f"pad_{repeats}_prime_4", prompt(4, repeats))
        run(f"pad_{repeats}_replay_4", prompt(4, repeats))
        cached = run(f"pad_{repeats}_increment_5", prompt(5, repeats))
        reference = run(f"pad_{repeats}_uncached", prompt(5, repeats), skip=True)
        assert cached == reference
    assert llm.reset_prefix_cache()
    run("long_tail_prime_4", prompt(4, tail=500))
    cached = run("long_tail_increment_5", prompt(5, tail=500))
    reference = run("long_tail_uncached", prompt(5, tail=500), skip=True)
    assert cached == reference
    assert llm.reset_prefix_cache()
    run("text_prime", prompt(0, tail=500))
    cached = run("text_replay", prompt(0, tail=500))
    reference = run("text_uncached", prompt(0, tail=500), skip=True)
    assert cached == reference
finally:
    llm.llm_engine.engine_core.shutdown()
```

</details>

## Details

Matching attention hashes are insufficient when Mamba `align` has no state before the sibling's divergence. A producer with a long text tail can retain only an end-of-prompt state that is already past the next request's shared prefix.

This change exposes `Request.last_mm_feature_end`, stops prefill at its physical-block-aligned position, and retains that checkpoint through the existing replay-boundary mechanism. It changes no model math, CUDA kernels or model-runner APIs. Shared prefixes shorter than one physical Mamba block still cannot reuse a state; preemption may recompute the extra split.

The baseline's zero-hit 448px output anomaly was isolated in three repeats: a discovered 2112-token junction changes chunking and BF16 gate projections; disabling only that junction restores the skip-cache output. This explains that reproducer, not the unresolved long-output failures above.

Unlike the application-directed checkpoint APIs in #55873/#55875/#55876, this uses one automatic final-MM boundary. #60888 optimizes checkpoint export rather than selecting that boundary; #55868/#60033/#60524 address separate GDN numerical paths. Those numerical changes are not included in this PR.
